page: Microsoft Azure ND128isr_GB300_v6 is an isolated, RDMA-capable server instance belonging to the NDISRGB300V6 family. It is equipped with 128 dedicated vCPUs utilizing an arm64 CPU architecture, managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system is provisioned with 864.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 6.75 GB of RAM per core.

For storage-intensive operations, the instance includes 16408 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and supports Premium Storage configurations. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single integrated GPU. Network capabilities include RDMA support, though the instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high density of local NVMe SSD storage and the inclusion of a dedicated GPU, this instance is positioned for workloads requiring high-throughput local storage and parallel computing capabilities. The hardware profile is suitable for large-scale database deployments, distributed data processing, and GPU-accelerated machine learning workloads. The isolated nature of the deployment provides hardware-level separation for sensitive workloads.
